sessions.title: Opening Ceremony
sessions.notes: Senior leaders, partners, and Fleet attendees officially open the exposition.

sessions.title: Acting Secretary of the Navy Address
sessions.notes: Acting SecNav gave a speech and answered questions. Date/stage confirmed via DVIDS.

sessions.title: Everyone Fights: A Senior Enlisted Perspective on Preparing Marines for the Next 250 Years
sessions.notes: Panel of four Sergeants Major. Ruiz = 20th Sergeant Major of the Marine Corps; Reiff = Sergeant Major, Manpower and Reserve Affairs; Gnecco = Sergeant Major, II MEF; Krause = Senior Enlisted Advisor to the Sergeant Major of the Marine Corps. Date confirmed via DVIDS.

sessions.title: Drone Zone Demonstrations
sessions.notes: Autonomous and remotely operated systems tested and displayed in real-time environments.

sessions.title: GCE UAS/C-UAS Symposium
sessions.notes: Drives rapid information exchange between HQMC, FMF operators, and industry on UAS and C-UAS friction, current programs, and operator-to-developer partnerships.

sessions.title: OBJ 1 Wargaming Sessions
sessions.notes: Interactive computer-based and tabletop wargaming exploring operational scenarios, tactics, and strategic concepts.

sessions.title: Aviation Modernization Panel
sessions.notes: Rusnok = Cunningham Group Branch Head, Deputy Commandant for Aviation; Finneran = Assistant Deputy Commandant for Aviation. Date confirmed via DVIDS captions. Stage inferred (likely Main Briefing or Acquisitions).

sessions.title: Acquisition Logistics Briefing
sessions.notes: Cross = Deputy Commander for Systems Engineering and Acquisition Logistics, Marine Corps Systems Command. Date confirmed via DVIDS. Stage inferred.

sessions.title: Counter-UAS / Ground Based Air Defense Briefing
sessions.notes: Konicki = Program Manager for Ground Based Air Defense, Portfolio Acquisition Executive–Marine Corps. Stage inferred (likely GCE UAS/C-UAS Symposium or Acquisitions Stage).

sessions.title: Marine Zone Sessions – Day 2
sessions.notes: Expert discussions on training, education, manpower, talent management, and community services.

sessions.title: Warfighting Pavilion Sessions – Day 2
sessions.notes: Force design, experimentation, and capabilities integration discussions.

sessions.title: State of the United States Marine Corps
sessions.notes: Caudle = Adm., Chief of Naval Operations; Austin = Lt. Gen., CG Marine Corps Combat Development Command / DC CD&I; Walsh = Maj. Gen., Deputy Director PAE-MC; Campbell = Brig. Gen., Commander MCSC; Bowdren = SES, Executive Deputy Director PAE-MC; Nasca = Col., Director Operations Analysis Directorate CD&I; Morris = Director of Operations, Plans, Policies and Operations. Date confirmed via DVIDS.

sessions.title: Ground Systems Enterprise Senior Leader Summit
sessions.notes: Two-day summit bringing Service leaders face-to-face with Fleet Marines and industry innovators around development and procurement of ground combat systems. Exact start/end and individual speakers not confirmed in available public records.

sessions.title: Logistics Command Artificial Intelligence Forum
sessions.notes: MARCORLOGCOM hosts forum bringing together leaders from DoW, industry, and academia to exchange advanced analytic concepts with military application. Individual speakers not confirmed in available public records.

sessions.title: Warfighting Pavilion Sessions – Day 3
sessions.notes: Force design, experimentation, and capabilities integration discussions.

sessions.title: Closing Ceremony
sessions.notes: Tracy = President, Marine Corps University. Conducted closing ceremony. Date confirmed via DVIDS.
